## 2026 Investment Outlook. # Top of Mind: The allocator’s checklist for 2026 and beyond. The value of your investment may become worth more or less than at the time of original investment. I’m excited to share my annual 10-step checklist, aimed at helping allocators define and document priorities for the year ahead and pave the way for greater impact. For each step of the checklist below, I offer a key takeaway to help make 2026 agendas as focused as possible. I’ll start with a look back at market results in 2025 (through the end of November), as well as 2024 and 2023 (**Figure 1**). The overall complexion of these three years is quite similar: Returns were strong for equities, reasonable for credit, lower for government bonds, and a mixed bag for commodities. Equity returns are expected to outpace fixed income, with non-US equities ahead of US equities — a somewhat different outlook than the 6- to 12-month view mentioned earlier.
